  • Throw away anything that is garbage (broken items, doo-dads, thingamabobs that you can't remember what they're for, etc.)

  • Recycle papers you no longer need (old receipts, expired coupons/menus, etc.)

  • Relocate anything that doesn't belong in this drawer

Just doing those 2 things will likely already get rid of a lot of things from this drawer!

  • Get rid of chargers for electronics you no longer have and dispose all expired batteries

  • If you choose to keep tools in this drawer, only keep the bare minimum, so you can quickly grab them for a small project (e.g. store a multi-bit screwdriver here rather than several screwdrivers)

Things to think about

Keep in mind the location of this drawer.

Junk drawers are PRIME REAL-ESTATE so they should ONLY contain items we need and use.
